title: Explosive Warrior Dance
description: Four sequential panels show a young Black girl with spiky dreadlocks performing a dynamic martial arts dance. She wears an ornate orange and black armored outfit with belts and straps. In the third panel, a bright orange fiery explosion erupts from her hands as she strikes a powerful pose.
